writer.name: Claude Opus 5.5, the hypnosis guide lane's writer (the splices and their fixes; the words are Emulate's)

findings.label: D9 follows the source order
examples: 1/1 paragraphs follow the source's points in its order (agreement 1.00); fine if each part notices something; check T13 and T09 in the tell ledger
findings.reason: It is Emulate's rewrite of the passage it replaces, so it follows that passage's points in order by design, with Emulate's own asides and turns ("if I can put it that way", "of course", "just", "!").

findings.label: E36/E41 heavy second person
findings.reason: The guide speaks to the reader as "you" throughout; these lines give the reader one step or one check inside a paragraph that is not a run of coaching lines.

findings.label: O14 two repeated "and"s or "or"s in one stretch: fine in speech ("bread and butter and jam"), Emulate's trick in a list (Joel 2026-10-07)
examples: Is this way of responding helping you to be clearer and steadier and less hooked?
findings.reason: His three outcomes (clearer, steadier, less hooked) asked as a spoken question to the reader; the "and ... and" is the question's spoken register, not a written list.
